name: Terminal Earth
description:
About This Game

🎮 Pitch

Terminal Earth is a solo sci-fi survival extraction shooter where a lone survivor undertakes increasingly dangerous missions on an alien-harvested Earth, guided by a moon-based rebellion, in a world that actively tries to kill you.

🚀 Key Features

  • Single-player extractor shooter with roguelike progression
    Risk everything on each run — extract safely to keep your loot.

  • Fast, tactical top-down combat
    Dash, jump, reposition, and survive against overwhelming threats.

  • Procedurally generated missions
    Every deployment offers new layouts, objectives, enemy combinations, and unexpected danger.

  • Four mission types with escalating stakes

    • Scavenge resources for the resistance

    • Destroy alien installations

    • Eliminate powerful enemy leaders

    • Take down massive alien motherships

  • Multiple enemy factions

    • Alien invasion forces

    • Heavy alien combat mechs

    • Undead zombie hordes

    • Mixed encounters where enemies clash and overwhelm the battlefield

  • Dynamic world events
    Meteor strikes, ion storms, giant creatures, and other unpredictable threats can erupt mid-mission.

  • Dangerous biomes that change how you play
    Each biome affects movement, combat flow, and survival tactics.

  • A hostile, evolving Earth
    Abandoned cities, ruined facilities, and war-torn landscapes filled with zombies, aliens, and machines.

  • High-risk, high-reward extraction gameplay
    Push deeper for better loot — or extract early to stay alive.

  • Meaningful progression
    Increase your reputation to unlock harder missions, tougher enemies, and greater rewards.

  • Moon base hub: New Moon
    Prepare your loadout, choose your next mission, and return to Earth when ready.

  • Dark sci-fi survival atmosphere
    A fallen Earth shaped by invasion, chaos, and constant danger.
